name: mailchimp-mcp-server
description: Draft, test, and send Mailchimp campaigns straight from your MCP client — with audience management, subscriber CRUD, and post-send analytics behind safe-by-default send gates. STDIO or Streamable HTTP.

MAILCHIMP_API_KEY.title: Mailchimp API Key
MAILCHIMP_API_KEY.description: Mailchimp Marketing API key, including the '-dc' data-center suffix (e.g. 'abc...-us22'). Generate at Mailchimp → Account → Extras → API keys.

MAILCHIMP_BASE_URL.title: Mailchimp Base URL
MAILCHIMP_BASE_URL.description: Override the API base URL (for mock servers or testing). Defaults to 'https://{dc}.api.mailchimp.com/3.0' derived from the API key suffix.

MAILCHIMP_MAX_RETRIES.title: Max Retries
MAILCHIMP_MAX_RETRIES.description: Max retry attempts for transient upstream failures (0-10).

MAILCHIMP_CONCURRENCY_LIMIT.title: Concurrency Limit
MAILCHIMP_CONCURRENCY_LIMIT.description: Max in-flight upstream requests across this process (1-10).

MAILCHIMP_ASSETS_DIR.title: Assets Directory
MAILCHIMP_ASSETS_DIR.description: Absolute path to a local assets directory. When set, enables the mailchimp_assets tool and auto-uploads @assets/<path> references in campaign HTML to Mailchimp File Manager at send time.

MAILCHIMP_TEMPLATES_DIR.title: Templates Directory
MAILCHIMP_TEMPLATES_DIR.description: Absolute path to a local templates directory. When set, enables the mailchimp_local_templates tool and support for content.localTemplate on campaign tools.

MCP_LOG_LEVEL.title: Log Level
MCP_LOG_LEVEL.description: Minimum log level for output (debug, info, notice, warning, error).
